claim: P95 MEASUREMENT: the compliance stage — new at P93, previously only smoke-run at 10 files per format — was pointed at the full docx (2333) and pptx (720) corpora for the first time. pptx is clean at 715/715. docx found two introduced defects; one was a silent image-loss bug in the OPC reader, now fixed, leaving a single pathological LibreOffice fixture.

closed_in_p95.symptom: blip_fill_integrity: <a:blip r:embed="rId4"> target "media/image1.tmp" not found in package (libreoffice/fdo65833.docx).
closed_in_p95.root_cause: _is_zip_trash treated any entry ending .tmp/.bak/.swp/~ as an editor backup. The package declares <Default Extension="tmp" ContentType="image/png"/> and references word/media/image1.tmp from a relationship — it is a part. The reader deleted it, the rel went dangling, and save() wrote a document whose image was gone.
closed_in_p95.impact: Silent data loss on open/save. Preserve missed it because the part was dropped consistently on both sides of the comparison; only the compliance stage, which validates the output against the rules rather than against the input, named it.
closed_in_p95.fix: A [Content_Types].xml Override or Default outranks the backup-suffix heuristic. Location-based trash ([trash]/, __MACOSX/, .DS_Store, ~$lock) is still dropped unconditionally.
closed_in_p95.verification: fdo65833.docx open->save now loses zero entries; docx compliance_introduced 2 -> 1.

open_items.root_cause: The source deliberately ships both word/document.xml and WORD/DOCUMENT.XML as separate ZIP entries. Both load as distinct parts and the writer emits a rels item for each; under OPC case-insensitive comparison the two rels items are the same part name.
open_items.note: Pathological LibreOffice fixture, not a shape seen outside it. The fix is to fold case-duplicate parts on load rather than to special-case the writer.

open_items.symptom: Triaged: 14 non-ZIP (12 libreoffice, 2 openoffice), 4 missing [Content_Types].xml, 4 malformed XML in the main part (tag mismatch, duplicate w:val, invalid StartTag, trailing content).
open_items.note: Every one is a deliberately corrupt bug-repro fixture from the LibreOffice/phpoffice suites. Rejecting them is correct behaviour, not a gap.

open_items.symptom: Triaged: 4 non-ZIP (incl. libreoffice/empty.pptx, a zero-content fixture, and phpoffice/SamplePassword.pptx, an encrypted OLE2 container) and 1 malformed XML (phpoffice/Sample_01_Simple.pptx, bad attribute name at line 25).
open_items.note: SamplePassword.pptx is the only one with a plausible future path — ooxml-core ships opc/crypto.py, so agile-encrypted packages could be opened with a password rather than reported as non-ZIP.

next_gate: P96 requires docx compliance_introduced == 0 with docx-casing-duplicate-rels-part resolved, the open-failure triage is now recorded.
notes: Compliance counts only findings absent from the source package. The docx figures above are the post-fix re-run (/tmp/p95b); the first run at 103d288's parent read compliance_introduced 2. pptx was not re-run — its single change is in the shared OPC reader and its introduced count was already 0.
